meta.name: predictleads-dashboard
meta.description: Use when a teammate wants to visually browse PredictLeads signals already cached in local SQLite — triggers include "dashboard for [domains]", "visualize signals for [list]", "show signals as a dashboard", "HTML view of [client lookalikes]", or any request to scan many companies' signals at a glance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浏览已缓存的商业信号仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速浏览多家公司的商业信号。
copy.tagline_en: Browse cached business signals in a dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly scan business signals for multiple companies.

howto.what: 从本地SQLite数据库中读取已缓存的PredictLeads信号，生成一个自包含的HTML仪表板页面。页面以卡片形式展示每个公司，包含信号计数、顶部信号、可展开的详细数据（如招聘、新闻、融资、技术栈、相似公司），支持按垂直领域过滤和按信号密度或时间排序。
howto.when: 当用户要求以视觉方式浏览已缓存的信号时触发，例如说“dashboard for [domains]”、“visualize signals for [list]”、“show signals as a dashboard”或“HTML view of [client lookalikes]”。前提是信号已通过signals:fetch拉取到本地缓存。
